title.zh: 将若干特别或周转基金在若干条件下的现金结余归还国家政府一般基金的法案
title.en: An Act Reverting to the General Funds of the National Government the Cash Balances of Certain Special or Revolving Funds Under Certain Conditions
title.orig: An Act Reverting to the General Funds of the National Government the Cash Balances of Certain Special or Revolving Funds Under Certain Conditions

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2361_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the whole or any such portion of any outstanding cash balance of any special or revolving fund upon certification by the head of the office administering the said fund and attestation by the Auditor General to the effect that the purpose or purposes for which the said fund was created had been fulfilled or abandoned or that the said amount of cash balance or any portion thereof is no longer needed without adversely affecting the purpose or purposes for which the said funds was created had been fulfilled, is hereby transferred to the general funds of the national government.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1959.
